about: English translations of changed BWIKI notes and effects from the November 2026 update.

texts.光暗国家队，游戏中绝大多数站桩限时dps检测本最优解: The standard Light/Dark team is the best pick for most timed DPS checks where you can stay in place.
texts.对前方小范围敌人造成4000%物理强度的物理伤害。(本技能会受攻速影响，造成的伤: Deals Physical DMG equal to 4000% of Physical Power to enemies in a small area in front. Attack Speed affects this skill, and its damage counts as Basic Attack DMG.
texts.指定一名敌方角色进入“生死决斗”6秒。期间双方仅会受到彼此造成的伤害，期间也无法: Challenges an enemy to a Duel to the Death for 6 seconds. The duelists can only damage each other and cannot regenerate Rage naturally. Damage, healing, Rage recovery, shields, and crowd control from other units have no effect. The duel ends immediately if either duelist dies. The caster deals 100% more damage during the duel.
texts.当近战攻击范围内没有敌人时，会快速的朝最近的敌人冲刺，并对其施加2秒的沉默，如果: If no enemy is in melee range, dashes to the nearest enemy and Silences them for 2 seconds. If an enemy is in range, deals Physical DMG equal to 5000% of Physical Power and Silences them for 2 seconds.
texts.【剑道争锋】持续期间击杀对方黑卫时，会偷取目标10%物理强度和法术强度。(如果目: Killing an enemy Blackguard during [Duel of Blades] steals 10% of their Physical Power and Spell Power. Killing a monster increases the caster's Physical Power by the corresponding amount.
texts.【剑道争锋】持续期间受到攻击时，10%几率触发反击，抵消当次受到的伤害，并对攻击: When hit during [Duel of Blades], has a 10% chance to counter, negate that hit, and deal Physical DMG equal to 20000% of Physical Power to the attacker. Each 10 points of Bravery above the opponent's increases the trigger chance by 1%.
texts.【大音希声】还会额外对目标施加普攻易伤，使其受到的普攻伤害提升30%，持续6秒。: [Silent Thunder] also makes the target take 30% more Basic Attack DMG for 6 seconds.
texts.【抽刀断水】每次释放后还会增加40%[后发制人\n】造成的伤害，最多叠加5次。: Each cast of [Water-Cleaving Draw] also increases [Opportune Counter] damage by 40%, stacking up to 5 times.
texts.每释放5次【抽刀断水】必定会触发一次【后发之刃】且不会消耗血阶1的叠层效果。: Every 5 casts of [Water-Cleaving Draw] trigger [Counterblade] without consuming the stacks from Blood Rank 1.
texts.【剑道争锋】持续时间结束时，如果未完成击杀，则血量剩余百分比更多的黑卫将偷取目标: If neither duelist dies before [Duel of Blades] ends, the Blackguard with the higher remaining HP percentage steals 5% of the target's Power stats. Against a monster, the caster always gains 5% Physical Power instead.
texts.【剑道争锋】偷取的强度会对己方所有黑卫起效。: Power stolen by [Duel of Blades] is granted to all allied Blackguards.
texts.在竞技场进攻时【大音希声】可以指定对方一名黑卫，且云梦归人可以对无敌状态的敌人造: On offense in the Arena, [Silent Thunder] can target an enemy Blackguard, and Dreambound Wanderer can damage invulnerable enemies.
texts.【无垢之境】造成的伤害会附加司正天座最大生命值20%的神圣伤害，且命中时有45%: [Realm of Purity] deals additional Holy DMG equal to 20% of Lumina's Max HP. Hits have a 45% chance to reduce the enemy's Physical Power and Spell Power by 6% for 6 seconds. Stacks up to 10 times.
texts.【溯光】每次受伤转化的最大生命值最多（根据技能等级）提升至75%，且每次受伤时，: [Tracing Light] raises the cap on Max HP gained from each hit to 75%, depending on skill level. Each hit also grants 50 Physical Armor and Spell Armor.
texts.免疫即死效果，且【天光乍破】叠加耀斑同时，会使其受到的治疗效果下降10%，最多叠: Immune to instant death. When [First Light] applies Flare, it also reduces the target's healing received by 10% for 6 seconds. Stacks up to 10 times.
texts.云梦归人佩戴时，造成的所有伤害增加5%+25%: When equipped by Dreambound Wanderer, increases all damage dealt by 5%+25%.
texts.进入战斗的前5秒，云梦归人处于无敌状态。: Dreambound Wanderer is invulnerable for the first 5 seconds of battle.
